label: UI Review
description: Review interface layout, hierarchy, visual polish, accessibility, or usability.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether an interface looks or feels right.

label: Interaction Design
description: Design states, flows, controls, and interaction behavior.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how a UI should behave across workflows.

label: Visual Direction
description: Define visual style, hierarchy, mood, layout direction, or asset guidance.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for visual direction, composition, design polish, or creative UI treatment.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for code-level bug diagnosis.

label: Prototype Design
description: Design prototype structure, screens, or flows.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for a prototype or mock flow.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for backend architecture only.

label: Design System Work
description: Define or review components, tokens, states, and visual rules.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for design system guidance.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for database schema only.

label: Accessibility Review
description: Review UI accessibility, contrast, semantics, and interaction clarity.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether UI is accessible.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for legal accessibility compliance only.

label: Content Layout
description: Design page structure, information hierarchy, and content placement.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to lay out content.

label: Usability Test Planning
description: Plan usability tests, tasks, observations, and evaluation criteria.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how to test usability.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for automated unit tests.

label: Responsive Design
description: Review or design responsive and mobile UI behavior.

classifier.useWhen: User asks how UI should adapt to screen sizes.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for server scaling review.

label: Visual QA
description: Inspect visual implementation for polish, overlap, spacing, and hierarchy.

classifier.useWhen: User asks whether UI rendering looks correct.
